sources.excerpt: Published on October 13, 2004 Danelectro mini effects octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal schematics Controls Level controls the output volume Dist controls the amount of distortion Octave turns the "octave up" effect on and off EQ controls the tone (bass/treble?) Information Danelectro A faithful re-issue of the Foxx Tone Machine from the early 70's-at an incredible price! Best "octave up" effect around! the Foxx Tone Machine was invented by Steve Ridinger, the current president of the Danelectro/Evets Corp. at age 19!
